Tom Hardy brings a certain quality to his roles that has made him one of the most famous actors. Despite his deeply imposing masculine persona, the actor delivers flawless comedy without looking like he's trying too hard. He has given numerous dramatic roles mixed with comedy in TV shows and blockbusters. This charisma makes him the perfect person to play one of the lead characters in Ronan Bennett's thriller, which is heavily inspired by Guy Ritchie's aesthetic.

Hardy plays Harry De Souza, a fixer working with London's criminal families to keep the peace or destroy it when necessary. As one of the people with the most access to these families, he knows intimate details and has done a lot for them, including torture and murder. Still, it is easy to root for Harry because Hardy plays him as a badass who will threaten your life casually. This show, MobLand, also features performances from Pierce Brosnan and Helen Mirren, who bring their own brands of intensity and comedy.

Since its premiere last year, MobLand has become very popular on streaming, setting the record for the most-watched foreign show on Paramount+ in the U.S. It was soon after renewed for Season 2, which premiered on September 18, and the second season is still replicating that success, according to live rankings from FlixPatrol. MobLand is the most-watched show on Paramount+, dethroning Taylor Sheridan's Lioness, which has been dominating for weeks. The series is also available to stream internationally through Prime Video and SkyShowtime depending on the country, and this success has carried over. A licensing agreement brought the first season to Netflix, where it is also seeing similar success.
